top_signals.title: US Gas Pump Price Hits 8-Month Low to Ease Inflation Worries
top_signals.summary: US gasoline pump prices fell to the lowest since mid-March following a broader decline in oil markets this month, in a sign that inflationary pressures from the Iran war are beginning to ease.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Nvidia faces ‘complete evaporation of confidence’ as board rules out Huang return
top_signals.summary: Nvidia shares slipped further on Tuesday ahead of its crucial third quarter earnings announcement, as analysts warned the AI chip giant faces a “complete evaporation of confidence” without a clear stabilisation plan and blowout results. The stock closed 4.1 per cent lower at $156.14 on Monday and fell a further 0.5 per cent in pre-market [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
